entities.name: Macedonian & Roman Conquest
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Philip II of Macedon conquered Thrace (341 BCE). Roman incorporation created the provinces of Thrace and Moesia (46 CE), with Serdica (Sofia), Philippopolis (Plovdiv), and Augusta Traiana as major urban centres.
